description: Header file defining the AudioPlayer class and related enums and callback classes for media playback, WebSocket communication, and audio processing.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class for audio playback management, including pipeline control, volume, and WebSocket communication.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified URL.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets primary and player volume levels.

methods.name: SetSmartVolControl
methods.description: Enables/disables smart volume control with parameters.

methods.name: push_data
methods.description: Pushes raw data into the player buffer.
